title: Daily Market Digest
subtitle: Markets Closed Today, Reporting on Friday, September 18, 2026 Session

sections.title: Market Pulse: Mixed Close Caps Choppy Week Driven by Fed Hike and Yields

items.headline: U.S. equities finished mixed on Friday, concluding a volatile week marked by the Federal Reserve's first interest rate hike in three years.
items.summary: The Nasdaq Composite led gains, buoyed by a surge in AI-related stocks, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average extended its weekly decline. Rising 10-year Treasury yields, which reached 5.00%, continued to exert pressure across the broader market.

items.headline: AI Bets Surge: Strategy Inc. (formerly MicroStrategy) Jumps on Bitcoin Rebound
items.summary: Strategy Inc. ($MSTR) rocketed 16.4% as Bitcoin reclaimed the $80,000 level, fueling a rally in crypto-related assets.

items.headline: Coinbase Rallies as SEC Paves Way for Tokenized Stocks
items.summary: Coinbase Global Inc. ($COIN) surged 11.39% after the SEC announced a five-year Innovation Exemption, establishing a legal pathway for tokenized U.S. stocks, boosting the digital assets sector.

items.headline: Xenon Pharmaceuticals Inc. Leads Declines
items.summary: Xenon Pharmaceuticals Inc. ($XENE) was among the steepest decliners, falling 30.69% during Friday's session. Specific news for the sharp decline was not immediately available.

items.headline: Netflix Slips on Downgrade and Viewer Concerns
items.summary: Netflix ($NFLX) shares dropped 4.7% after Wells Fargo downgraded the stock, citing worrying viewer trends and a lack of breakout hits.

items.headline: Federal Reserve Implements First Rate Hike in Three Years Amid Inflation Concerns
items.summary: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates by a quarter-point this week, marking its first hike in three years. Chair Kevin Warsh's terse statement and market pricing suggest the possibility of one to two additional hikes before year-end, impacting interest-sensitive sectors and borrowing costs.

items.headline: Technology and Healthcare Lead Weekly Sector Gains; Utilities and Financials Lag
items.summary: For the week, Technology (up 1.43%) and Healthcare (up 1.18%) were the best-performing sectors, with a notable rotation of money into AI-adjacent names. Conversely, Utilities (down 2.95%) and Financial Services (down 2.29%) were the worst performers, with banks facing pressure from rising rates.

items.headline: 10-Year Treasury Yield Touches 5.00%, Signaling Continued Market Pressure
items.summary: The yield on the 10-year Treasury note climbed to 5.00% on Friday, reaching levels not seen since 2007. This key benchmark remains a critical level for investors, with potential implications for equity valuations, particularly in growth-sensitive sectors like AI.

items.headline: Warren Buffett Steps Down as Berkshire Hathaway Chairman
items.summary: Iconic investor Warren Buffett announced he is stepping down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway after 56 years, transitioning to chairman emeritus. His son, Howard Buffett, will assume the chairman role.
